vb_textbox.text: The game changes and nothing is fixed. After applying one rule that pays good points and repeating it to get more points, the game changes and you will have to adapt and try out other options when the points gets low. The hats are made of various colors and I used the colors to make my rules. When I started I selected bright colors like red, yellow and green cause I observed they gave me good points after a while the points got poor and i selected other options to form a new theory to accumulate my points. I try randomly and get four colors that pays good and I say the four colors out loud while performing the experiment and then when the game changes I observe new colors and continue same strategy. Overall, my strategy is based entirely on my memory and observation.
